doc.title: Forget Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet directive

segments.exact: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.
segments.note: Instructs removal/forgetting of specified content; imperative mood.

segments.exact: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.
segments.note: Second, distinct directive act — targets zeppelin routes specifically, separate from the fleet/contracts directive above.
